title: AI as Interactive Tutor: Learning Quaternions with ChatGPT
description: Matt Webb's experience using ChatGPT as an interactive tutor to learn quaternions for Galactic Compass 2 AR app. Key insight: 'Learning doesn't stop just because I outsource a bunch of thinking to AI. It pushes me to learn more.' Demonstrates AI's role as educational catalyst rather than replacement for learning.
author: Matt Webb (curated by Simon Willison)

title: Stop Making TUIs: Coding Agents Enable Native GUIs
description: Thomas Ptacek advocates for building native user interfaces instead of Text User Interfaces (TUIs) because 'coding agents have reduced the cost of getting a usable-enough GUI up and running to almost nothing.' Simon Willison reflects on his vibe-coded bandwidth and GPU monitoring macOS task bar apps and the shift toward GUI applications powered by AI coding agents.
author: Thomas Ptacek (curated by Simon Willison)

title: ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
description: Research paper introducing ReWorld, an interactive world model with long-horizon memory capabilities. Addresses one of the key challenges in agentic AI: maintaining context and memory across extended reasoning chains. 21 pages, 9 figures, with project page available.
author: Zhifei Chen, Luozhou Wang, Guibao Shen, Dongyu Yan, Shuai Yang, Tianshuo Xu, Yihua Du, Wei Wang, Tianyi Gui, Lianghua Huang, Yingcong Chen

title: Prime Agent: A Self-Improving RLM Harness
description: Technical report on Prime Agent, a self-improving Reinforcement Learning Model harness. Represents ongoing research into agents that can improve their own capabilities through experience. 16 pages, 10 figures with code available.
author: Seth Karten, Alex L. Zhang, Kevin Thomas, Sebastian Müller, Elie Bakouch, Daniel Auras, Mika Senghaas, Fares Obeid, Konstantin Dunas, Johannes Hagemann, Sami Jaghouar

title: How AI Assistance Affects Human Skill Development
description: Study accepted at HCOMP 2026 examining how AI assistance affects human skill development using logic puzzles as a test case. Addresses critical question: Does AI help or hinder learning? Findings relevant to education and training in AI-assisted environments.
author: Shang Wu, Catarina G Belem, Shuyuan Fu, Mark Steyvers, Padhraic Smyth

title: AgentWeave: Routing Before Reasoning for Efficient Function Calling
description: Research on optimizing function calling in tool-rich language models by implementing routing before reasoning. Addresses efficiency challenges in agentic AI systems. Open-source implementation available with 12 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables.
author: Saurav Singla, Aarav Singla, Advik Gupta, Parnika Gupta

title: AutoSaddler: Automatic Harness Optimization with Agent Execution Traces
description: Research on automatic harness optimization using durable updates from agent execution traces. Addresses software testing and agent reliability challenges. 44 pages, 15 figures with project website and code available.
author: Sungho Park, Wonjoong Kim, Rongyuan Tan, Jue Zhang, Wook-Shin Han, Pengfei Gao, Chanyoung Park, Yongqiang Yao, Rao Fu, Elsie Nallipogu, Qingwei Lin, Saravan Rajmohan, Dongmei Zhang

title: What Process Evaluation of Coding Agents Actually Measures
description: Research examining evaluation metrics for coding agents, arguing that 'Action, Task, and Step Are Three Different Levels.' Addresses fundamental questions about how we measure and evaluate AI coding agent performance. 38 pages, 8 figures.
author: Jiawei He, Mengyu Shi, Jie Jia, Xikai Yang, Dong Sun

title: Concepts for Securing Agentic AI Coding and the Terok Environment
description: Research on security concepts for agentic AI coding systems, introducing the Terok environment. To be published at AGENSYS workshop at ECML PKDD 2026. Addresses critical security challenges in AI-powered development environments.
author: Jiří Vyskočil, Franz Pöschel, Andreas Knüpfer

title: Agent-G²: Gaussian Guidance for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
description: Research on Gaussian Guidance for agentic reinforcement learning systems. Code and project page available. Represents advances in training agentic AI systems using novel reinforcement learning approaches.
author: Zixuan Wang, Yanrui Miao, Zhengxi Lu, Teng Pan, Yiwen Qiu, Hongxing Li, Peng Qiu, Ruiqing Zhang, Yongliang Shen

title: SRPO: Self-Reflective Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Reasoning
description: Research on Self-Reflective Policy Optimization (SRPO) for long-horizon reasoning tasks. Accepted to ICML 2026. Addresses challenges in maintaining coherent reasoning across extended tasks.
author: Jialong Liu, Yuling Shi, Ning Yang, Xiaodong Gu, Zuchao Li

title: From Generation to Simulation: How Far Are World Models from Being True Simulators?
description: 42-page paper examining how far world models are from being true simulators. With 23 figures and 2 tables. Project page available. Addresses fundamental questions about world model capabilities and limitations.
author: Tong Wang, Huan Deng, Mucheng Yang, Yang He, Xiaohui Kuang, Gang Zhao

title: LLM-based Agents for Forecasting and Prediction: Methods, Training, Evaluation, and Applications
description: Comprehensive survey on LLM-based agents for forecasting and prediction tasks. Covers methods, training, evaluation, and applications. Represents state-of-the-art understanding of predictive AI systems.
author: Xiaogang Xu, Jiaqi Tang, Jianmin Chen, Yingying Yan, Zhenchao Tang, Xiangxin Zhou, Xiaobin Hu, Wei Wei, Jinfeng Wu, Qifeng Chen, Lu Zhou, Jiafei Wu, Zhe Liu, Jianwei Yin, Weimin Zheng

title: PsychJail: Exploring Psychological Jailbreaks via Multi-Turn Persuasion of LLM Policies
description: Research on psychological jailbreaking techniques using multi-turn persuasion strategies to manipulate LLM policies. Addresses AI safety and security challenges.
author: Zeyu Feng, Qingyu Wu, Yuzhe Luo, Hua Cheng
